# Maximum Number of Words You Can Type.

@example "with" has a w and "lemon" an m; "green" and "tea" come out whole.
"green tea with lemon"
"wm"
=> 2

@example Nothing is broken, so all three words come out whole.
"jam on toast"
""
=> 3

@example Every word has an s in it.
"sun sets slowly"
"s"
=> 0

# A one-letter text, with nothing broken and with its letter broken.
"a"
""
=> 1

"a"
"a"
=> 0

# Only the last word comes out whole; no space follows it.
"zip zap top"
"z"
=> 1

# Only the last word is spoiled; the repeated word counts twice.
"top tip top zap"
"z"
=> 3

# The broken letter is the first letter of one word and the last of another.
"kiwi pear bark"
"k"
=> 1

# One word holds a broken letter twice, another two different broken
# letters: each is one spoiled word (counting broken letters gives -1).
"deed bad cat"
"bd"
=> 1

# Broken letters that never occur in text.
"brown fence"
"xyzq"
=> 2

# All 26 letters broken.
"the end"
"qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
=> 0

# The letters at both ends of the alphabet.
"zz aa mm az"
"az"
=> 1
